title: Should You Charge Extra for Oat Milk?

scenes.say: Should you charge extra for oat milk?
Say the dairy milk in a latte costs you a quarter. Oat milk, about a dollar. That's seventy-five cents more, every cup.
Thirty oat drinks a day, with no charge? That's about eight thousand dollars a year.

scenes.speaker: Maria
scenes.say: I don't mind paying a bit more. I just don't want a surprise at the till.

props.name: Maria
props.quote: Paying more is fine. A *surprise* isn't.

scenes.say: So: charge about the seventy-five cent gap. Show it on the menu board. Or add a little to every latte instead.

props.title: The fix
steps: Show it on the menu board
Or add a bit to every latte
